title: PAF Workbench Adapter Contract (Step 35)
description: The interface every workbench adapter implements. An adapter TRANSLATES framework behavior onto an execution surface; it never redefines governance, originates authority, or carries project-specific rules. Capability gaps are first-class: a gap that is merely noted is not mitigated.

translatesNeverRedefines.const: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.

noAuthorityOrigination.const: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.

noProjectGovernance.const: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.

noStateInvention.const: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.

noIndependenceCollapse.const: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.description: How this surface handles each framework capability. Every entry with support=CANNOT_SATISFY MUST carry a mitigation and a named risk acceptor.

cleanContextSupport.description: Whether this surface can produce a clean-context handoff for SEPARATE_INVOCATION_CLEAN_CONTEXT independence.
